company.name: BlueSand Digital
company.tagline: Website Enhancement for U.S. Small Businesses

hero.heading: Your business already has a website. Let's make it work harder.
hero.description: Most U.S. small business owners have a website — but it's not converting. We take what you already have and transform the UI and UX into something your visitors actually want to use.

services.name: E-commerce & Business Sites
services.bestFor: Full store, coaching, personal or business profile

process.title: Discovery Call
process.description: We review your current site, learn your goals, and map out what's holding you back. Free 30-minute call — no obligation.

process.title: Design Mockup
process.description: We create a visual mockup of your enhanced pages so you can approve the direction before we write a single line of code.

process.title: Build & Review
process.description: We build your site. You review. Two rounds of revisions are included so we get it exactly right.

process.title: Launch & Handoff
process.description: We push your site live, test across all devices, and hand over full ownership with a complete walkthrough video.

whyUs.title: Built for Small Business
whyUs.body: We work exclusively with U.S. small business owners. Your constraints, timelines, and budget matter — not just the project specs.

whyUs.title: Fast Turnaround
whyUs.body: Most agencies take months. We deliver in weeks. You get a first draft within days of kickoff, not a 6-week waiting period.

whyUs.title: Direct with Your Designer
whyUs.body: No account managers or middlemen. You work directly with the person building your site from day one through launch.

whyUs.title: UI + UX That Converts
whyUs.body: Every design decision is tied to keeping visitors engaged and moving toward your goal. We don't just make it look good — we make it work.

whyUs.title: Flat, Published Pricing
whyUs.body: No surprise invoices. Our pricing is posted publicly so you know exactly what you're paying before the first conversation.

whyUs.title: Secure by Default
whyUs.body: Every site we build ships with SSL, security headers, and best-practice configurations. Your visitors and data are protected.
